item_name: Rothco MOLLE II 100 Round SAW Pouch
item_short_desc: Rothco’s MOLLE II 100 Round SAW Pouch is expertly crafted to seamlessly integrate with your modular gear, providing reliable and convenient storage for your ammunition and other tactical essentials. This versatile pouch is MOLLE compatible, featuring 2 sturdy MOLLE straps on the back that ensure a secure attachment to your tactical vest, backpack, or duty belt. Designed to hold a SAW 100-round ammo box, 12-gauge shells, drum magazines, and more, this tactical pouch keeps your gear easily accessible and well-protected.
description: Rothco’s MOLLE II 100 Round SAW Pouch is expertly crafted to seamlessly integrate with your modular gear, providing reliable and convenient storage for your ammunition and other tactical essentials. This versatile pouch is MOLLE compatible, featuring 2 sturdy MOLLE straps on the back that ensure a secure attachment to your tactical vest, backpack, or duty belt. Designed to hold a SAW 100-round ammo box, 12-gauge shells, drum magazines, and more, this tactical pouch keeps your gear easily accessible and well-protected. The quick-release buckle adds an extra layer of security, keeping your items safe while allowing for fast and easy access when needed. Measuring 6.5 inch x 4.5 inch x 2.5 inch, this compact yet spacious MOLLE pouch is constructed from durable denier polyester material, with the MultiCam version made from denier Cordura nylon for added durability. Ideal for military personnel and shooting enthusiasts, Rothco’s MOLLE II 100 Round SAW Pouch is a must-have accessory for those who demand performance and reliability from their gear.
